answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Every claim climbs the lagoon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the signal re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the canyon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
